producers.name: Domaine de la Bressande
producers.intro: 2016 年创立的 Côte Chalonnaise 酒庄，经营 Rully、Mercurey 及 Hautes-Côtes de Beaune 葡萄园。Anne-Laure Hernette 负责酿造，Rully 酒款涵盖村庄级、多个一级园及 Vignes du Château de Rully 系列。
producers.scope: 已核对来源的酒庄与 Rully 酒款档案；非年份技术基线与指定年份记录分开。

sections.title: 规模与葡萄园
sections.text: 当前酒庄总览列超过 70 ha，涵盖多个产区。方法页另记 Rully 约 21.57 ha、14 个地块；各页面统计口径与更新时间不同，不能将总面积都视为 Rully。

sections.title: 栽培
sections.text: 酒庄称自 2020 年份获得 HVE 认证，采用产量控制、审慎植保及生物防治产品；HVE 不等于有机认证。

sections.title: 酿酒团队
sections.text: Anne-Laure Hernette 与葡萄园团队共同制定栽培方案，并负责酿造、熟成和调配。

sections.title: 酿造与熟成
sections.text: 红酒多去梗，在温控混凝土罐中发酵；白酒先压榨并冷沉淀，再于不锈钢罐开始发酵。桶陈、新桶比例与酒泥管理按具体年份酒款记录。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Molesme Blanc — Vignes du Château de Rully
wines.place: Château 葡萄园的 0.5 ha 南向 Chardonnay；棕色钙质土、坡脚粉土及 Oxfordian 石灰岩。
wines.method: 2024 年 9 月 20 日采收；气囊压榨、冷沉淀 48 小时，不锈钢罐发酵后入桶。228 L 桶细酒泥熟成 9 个月，30% 新桶。
wines.detail: 生产者 2024 风格记录：花香、烤面包与持久口感。
wines.vintageScope: 2024 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: South-facing 0.5 ha of Château Chardonnay, with brown calcareous soil, footslope silt and Oxfordian limestone.
en.method: Harvested 20 September 2024; pneumatic pressing, 48-hour cold settling and stainless-steel fermentation before barrelling. Nine months on fine lees in 228 L barrels, 30% new.
en.detail: Producer's 2024 note: flowers, toast and persistence.
en.vintageScope: Official 2024 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Clos de la Bressande Monopole — Vignes du Château de Rully
wines.place: 城堡脚下 2.60 ha 围墙葡萄园，东南向，黏土石灰岩。
wines.method: 9 月 20 日采收；气囊压榨，12°C 冷沉淀 24 小时；13–18°C 不锈钢罐起发，发酵中转桶。228 L 桶及少量 500 L 桶细酒泥熟成 8 个月，至 MLF 前每周搅桶。
wines.detail: 生产者描述蜂蜜与烘烤香，酒体丰厚、余味长。
wines.vintageScope: 2024 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: Southeast-facing 2.60 ha walled vineyard below the château, on clay-limestone.
en.method: Harvested 20 September; pneumatic press, 24-hour settling at 12°C; fermentation starts in stainless steel at 13–18°C and continues after transfer. Eight months on fine lees in mostly 228 L and some 500 L barrels; weekly stirring until MLF.
en.detail: Producer describes honey and toast, generous texture and length.
en.vintageScope: Official 2024 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

wines.name: Rully Blanc — Vignes du Château de Rully
wines.place: Château 系列村庄级白酒；4.12 ha 棕色石灰质土，页面平均树龄约 20 年。
wines.method: 气囊压榨、冷沉淀 16–24 小时；不锈钢罐发酵末期转桶。细酒泥熟成 9 个月，约 20% 新桶；至 MLF 前每月约两次搅桶。
wines.detail: 生产者描述金银花、融合的木香与果味。
wines.vintageScope: 2024 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: Château-labelled village white; 4.12 ha on brown calcareous soil, with vines averaging about 20 years in the source.
en.method: Pneumatic press and 16–24-hour cold settling; transferred from stainless steel near fermentation's end. Nine months on fine lees, about 20% new oak; stirring roughly twice monthly until MLF.
en.detail: Producer describes honeysuckle, integrated oak and fruit.
en.vintageScope: Official 2024 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Chapitre Rouge
wines.place: Rully 北部、朝 Chagny 的坡地；酒庄 0.18 ha，棕色石灰质土，页面树龄约 15 年。
wines.method: 2022 年 8 月 29 日人工采收、小筐运输及分选；温控混凝土罐，每日淋皮、少量压帽。桶陈 8 个月，约 25% 新桶，装瓶前过滤。
wines.detail: 生产者 2022 描述红黑水果、包裹感与融合的橡木。
wines.vintageScope: 2022 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: Northern Rully slopes towards Chagny; estate parcel 0.18 ha on brown calcareous soil, source vine age about 15 years.
en.method: Hand-picked on 29 August 2022, transported in small crates and sorted. Temperature-controlled concrete, daily pump-overs and little punching down; eight months in oak, about 25% new, followed by filtration.
en.detail: Producer's 2022 note: red and black fruit, rounded texture and integrated oak.
en.vintageScope: Official 2022 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Grésigny Blanc
wines.place: 0.7 ha，强钙质棕色土；2021 页面树龄约 27 年。
wines.method: 9 月 27 日采收，气囊压榨，冷沉淀 12–24 小时；不锈钢罐发酵末期转桶。细酒泥熟成 8 个月，25% 新桶；至 MLF 前每月两次搅桶。
wines.detail: 生产者 2021 描述蜂蜜、花香和柔顺饱满的口感。
wines.vintageScope: 2021 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: 0.7 ha on strongly calcareous brown soil; the 2021 page gives vine age around 27 years.
en.method: Harvested 27 September; pneumatic pressing, 12–24-hour cold settling, then stainless-steel fermentation before barrelling. Eight months on fine lees, 25% new oak; twice-monthly stirring until MLF.
en.detail: Producer's 2021 note: honey, flowers and supple richness.
en.vintageScope: Official 2021 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru La Pucelle Blanc
wines.place: 1.5 ha；棕色石灰质、多石土壤及少量黏土坡积物，页面树龄约 40 年。
wines.method: 人工采收，气囊压榨及冷沉淀 16–24 小时；不锈钢罐发酵末期转桶。228 L 桶细酒泥熟成 9 个月，25% 新桶；至 MLF 前每月约两次搅桶。
wines.detail: 生产者 2024 描述柑橘、细致木香及紧致长余味。
wines.vintageScope: 2024 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: 1.5 ha with stony brown calcareous soils and some clay colluvium; source vine age about 40 years.
en.method: Hand harvest, pneumatic pressing and 16–24-hour cold settling; stainless-steel fermentation before barrelling. Nine months on fine lees in 228 L barrels, 25% new; stirring roughly twice monthly until MLF.
en.detail: Producer's 2024 note: citrus, fine oak and a taut, persistent finish.
en.vintageScope: Official 2024 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Molesme Rouge
wines.place: 约 3 ha Pinot Noir，东至东南向的平缓坡脚；Oxfordian 石灰岩。与 Château 系列白 Molesme 分开。
wines.method: 人工采收及两次分选；温控混凝土罐、每日淋皮、少量压帽。橡木桶 8 个月，25% 新桶，轻过滤装瓶。
wines.detail: 生产者 2024 描述樱桃、白胡椒、烘烤及烟草。
wines.vintageScope: 2024 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: About 3 ha of Pinot Noir on an east-southeast-facing footslope over Oxfordian limestone; separate from Château Molesme white.
en.method: Hand harvest and two-stage sorting; temperature-controlled concrete, daily pump-overs and little punching down. Eight months in oak, 25% new; lightly filtered.
en.detail: Producer's 2024 note: cherry, white pepper, toast and tobacco.
en.vintageScope: Official 2024 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Préaux Rouge
wines.place: 1.50 ha，棕色多石石灰质土；2023 页面记树龄约 53 年。
wines.method: 9 月 13 日人工采收；2023 工艺段记冷浸 72 小时、浸渍 14–20 天，温控混凝土罐中每日淋皮并少量压帽。桶陈 8 个月，25% 新桶，过滤装瓶。
wines.detail: 生产者描述胡椒、花香、黑醋栗及清新感。
wines.vintageScope: 2023 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: 1.50 ha on stony brown calcareous soil; the 2023 page gives vine age about 53 years.
en.method: Hand-picked 13 September; the explicit 2023 method specifies 72-hour cold soak and 14–20-day maceration, temperature-controlled concrete, daily pump-overs and some punching down. Eight months in oak, 25% new; filtered.
en.detail: Producer describes pepper, flowers, blackcurrant and freshness.
en.vintageScope: Official 2023 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

wines.name: Rully Blanc
wines.place: 三块葡萄园合计 2.6 ha，黏土石灰岩；页面平均树龄 30 年。与 Château 系列村庄白独立建档。
wines.method: 人工采收、气囊压榨及冷沉淀 16–24 小时；不锈钢罐发酵末期入 228 L 桶。细酒泥熟成 9 个月，20% 新桶；至 MLF 前每月约两次搅桶。
wines.detail: 生产者 2024 描述金银花、果味与融合的木香。
wines.vintageScope: 2024 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: Three parcels totalling 2.6 ha on clay-limestone; source average vine age 30 years. Separate from the Château-labelled village white.
en.method: Hand-picked and pneumatically pressed; 16–24-hour settling, stainless-steel fermentation and transfer to 228 L barrels. Nine months on fine lees, 20% new oak; stirring about twice monthly until MLF.
en.detail: Producer's 2024 note: honeysuckle, fruit and integrated oak.
en.vintageScope: Official 2024 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

wines.name: Rully Rouge
wines.place: 1.21 ha Pinot Noir，棕色多石石灰质土；页面树龄约 25 年。
wines.method: 人工采收、小筐运输，温控混凝土罐发酵，每日淋皮与少量压帽。桶陈 8 个月，约 20% 新桶，装瓶前过滤。
wines.detail: 生产者 2024 描述红黑水果、烘烤与细致但清晰的单宁。
wines.vintageScope: 2024 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: 1.21 ha of Pinot Noir on stony brown calcareous soil; source vine age about 25 years.
en.method: Hand harvest into small crates; temperature-controlled concrete fermentation with daily pump-overs and little punching down. Eight months in oak, about 20% new; filtered before bottling.
en.detail: Producer's 2024 note: red and black fruit, toast and fine but present tannins.
en.vintageScope: Official 2024 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

wines.name: Rully Saint-Jacques Blanc
wines.place: 村庄级，1.5 ha 黏土、粉土及石灰质土；页面树龄约 30 年。
wines.method: 9 月 19 日采收，直接压榨及冷沉淀 16–24 小时；不锈钢罐发酵末期入桶。细酒泥熟成 8 个月，25% 新桶；至 MLF 前每月约两次搅桶。
wines.detail: 生产者 2024 描述梨、菠萝、紫罗兰、轻木香及饱满酒体。
wines.vintageScope: 2024 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: Village-level 1.5 ha on clay-silt-limestone soil; source vine age about 30 years.
en.method: Harvested 19 September, directly pressed and cold-settled 16–24 hours; stainless-steel fermentation before barrelling. Eight months on fine lees, 25% new oak; stirring about twice monthly until MLF.
en.detail: Producer's 2024 note: pear, pineapple, violet, gentle oak and breadth.
en.vintageScope: Official 2024 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

en.intro: Founded in 2016, this Côte Chalonnaise estate works Rully, Mercurey and Hautes-Côtes de Beaune vineyards. Winemaker Anne-Laure Hernette oversees village and Premier Cru Rully wines, including the distinct Vignes du Château de Rully range.
en.scope: Source-reviewed producer and Rully wine records; label-level technical baselines are separated from identified vintages.

sections.title: Scale and vineyards
sections.text: The current estate overview gives over 70 ha across several appellations. The methods page separately records 21.57 ha in 14 Rully parcels; figures from different pages are not interchangeable.

sections.title: Viticulture
sections.text: The estate reports HVE certification from the 2020 vintage, yield control, reasoned protection and biocontrol products; HVE is not organic certification.

sections.title: Winemaking team
sections.text: Anne-Laure Hernette works with the vineyard team and directs vinification, ageing and blending.

sections.title: Winemaking and ageing
sections.text: Reds are mainly destemmed and fermented in temperature-controlled concrete. Whites are pressed, cold-settled and begin fermentation in stainless steel. Oak, lees management and timing are recorded by wine and vintage.

verification.scope: All 11 distinct Rully wine pages in the official Domaine de la Bressande portfolio, across three pagination pages. Château-labelled whites remain separate from estate wines. Latest available vintage on each page used; no later vintage invented.

issues.resolution: Use the explicit Vinification et élevage section: 72-hour cold soak, 14–20-day maceration. The earlier Origine block repeats a conflicting generic 24-hour process.
Only 2022 selectable on the current official page; retained as 2022, not relabelled 2023/2024.
Only 2021 selectable on the current official page; retained as 2021.
Some official prose places pre-fermentation after maceration in an inconsistent sequence. Retain unambiguous vessel, extraction and oak details, without reproducing the contradictory ordering.
Official bâtonnage wording says until alcoholic fermentation; omitted that ambiguous timing rather than silently substituting MLF.
Estate site contains 21.57 ha, 21.35 ha and an older 9.20 ha in different sections. Profile cites the methods page with explicit scope; no sum across pages.
